entries.subject: The colour of the photosphere
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at the published 3,650 K (Inglis et al. 2024, Table 1), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer into sRGB with the D65 white. Gaia DR3 has no BP/RP spectrum that describes this star alone, and no limb-darkening measurement or model grid in the repository reaches it, so the disc is uniform.
entries.revisitWhen: Gaia publishes a spectrum of this star alone, or a limb-darkening law is measured for it.

entries.subject: The two stars' radii in Inglis et al. (2024)
entries.finding: Table 1 gives 1.51 +/- 0.02 solar radii for A and 1.39 +/- 0.02 for B; the text of section 6 gives 1.42 +/- 0.01 and 1.59 +/- 0.02. The table is used; the difference is recorded, not resolved.
